title: Coordinatewise conjunction of sign strings
statement: For sign strings $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define their coordinatewise conjunction by $(x\wedge y)_i=x_i\wedge y_i$ at every coordinate, where the conjunction of two signs is $-1$ exactly when both are $-1$, and is $1$ otherwise.
